title: Complete PC Setup Walkthrough
description: Follow the visual, click-by-click instructions below to configure and play your titles on your system.

steps.title: Accessing the Setup Portal & Desktop App Link
steps.subtitle: Initial Setup
steps.instructions: go to lua.tools > then  click on "lua desktop app is here " displayes at center of screen
steps.clickHighlight: click on "lua desktop app is here " in purple at top

steps.title: Downloading & Running the Desktop Installer
steps.subtitle: Folder Linking
steps.instructions: click download button of installer says Download {11.4 mb} and install and if windows installer says dont run , no need to worry click on run anyway and it will install and allow for permissions if it asks any .
steps.clickHighlight: click download button of installer says Download {11.4 mb}

steps.title: Windows Security Configuration
steps.subtitle: Final Step
steps.instructions: Go to seetings then in it go to windows  security > then go to threat and protection and click on manage settings > then turn off real time protection
steps.clickHighlight: Go to seetings then in it go to windows  security > then go to threat and protection and click on manage settings > then turn off real time protection

steps.title: Initial Launch & Profile Configuration
steps.subtitle: Configuration
steps.instructions: once the lua app opens click on use recommended settings/profile and Log in the lua with discord

steps.title: Active Mode & Tool Verification
steps.subtitle: Configuration
steps.instructions: you are all set with the setup and go to mode in lua as mentioned and ensure that BetterSteamTools is installed if not then click on install. This will automatically open the  Steam app installed in your pc , if not open it by yourself

steps.title: Title Discovery & Library Search
steps.subtitle: Configuration
steps.instructions: all done , now go to  + Add , and in search bar type the name of game you want to install

steps.title: Manifest Fetch & Steam Installation
steps.subtitle: Configuration
steps.instructions: after selecting game just click on fetch , and it will automatically show in your library, and simply install and play
steps.clickHighlight: after selecting game just click on fetch
